args.rationale: Straight girder bridge; 2D spine beam, linear elastic beam-column elements.
6 spans, precast simply supported made continuous; no pier column geometry given so rigid supports, system = continuous.

Prestressed concrete unit weight, upper value 26.0.
Class I uniform lane load 10.5 kN/m.

Sliding bearing: vertical spring, longitudinal free.

args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam model of a 6×30 m precast prestressed small-box girder bridge, simply supported during erection and made continuous (structure.system = continuous; no pier column geometry given).

Key decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d (MR-01); system continuous (MR-05).
- Girder: 4 small-box girders combined. Midspan section integrated to A_single = 1.13893 m², I_single = 0.35492 m⁴; combined A = 4.55572 m², I = 1.41967 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec = 34500 MPa (C50, JTG 3362-3.1.5), γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-4.2.1), w = 118.449 kN/m, m = 12.074 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings: 8 laminated elastomeric bearings per support line (2 per girder end × 4 girders). Supports 0,1,2,4,5,6 = PTFE sliding (longitudinal free, Kh = 0); support 3 = plain elastomeric fixed (Kh = 24000 kN/m). S = 10.714, Kv = 1.1357×10⁷ kN/m for all lines; vertical spring, rotation free (MR-03/MR-04, JTG 3362-8.7).
- Lane load: 3 design lanes (JTG D60-4.3.1, Class I, one-way), ξ = 0.78, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320 kN per span. f1 = 3.513 Hz → μ = 0.2063 (JTG D60-4.3.2).

Model ran successfully: f1 = 3.513 Hz; max lane positive moment 8049 kN·m (span 1), max negative moment −5967 kN·m (support 1).
